items.source_item: Anti-Bureaucracy Law and Traveling Light operating-manual additions
items.intent: Remove controls that do not improve a decision or operational outcome and start useful work without blank-page delay
items.rationale: Triton already requires minimum sufficient assurance and control consolidation. The useful scaffold principle was added without universal 70-percent completeness or 15-minute authority, which could bypass risk assessment and approval.
items.protected_outcome: Low-friction execution with preserved obligations, traceability and rollback
items.follow_up_trigger: Measured evidence shows a recurring control without a consumer or a recurring blank-page delay

items.intent: Reduce post-sale uncertainty and deliver an early customer-recognised outcome
items.rationale: The staged onboarding and first-value intent is useful. Universal 2/24/48-hour promises, zero churn, fixed CSAT/NPS and neurological claims are unsupported across delivery classes and can rush regulated or incomplete work.
items.protected_outcome: Fast, trustworthy onboarding without false promises or assurance compression
items.follow_up_trigger: Closed onboarding cohorts provide comparable source-backed timing and value-realisation evidence

items.source_item: Cybersecurity and 24-hour agentic incident response policy
items.intent: Contain agentic, software, data and supply-chain security incidents and recover safely
items.rationale: The incident lifecycle, least privilege and evidence preservation are required. The source overclaims hermetic sandboxing, zero retention, continuous telemetry, one-click recovery and compliance; fixed financial and response thresholds are not justified for every incident or jurisdiction.
items.protected_outcome: Severity- and obligation-driven response with truthful capability status
items.follow_up_trigger: A dependency is activated or a representative containment and recovery exercise is approved

items.source_item: Binary founder energy selector and Low-Energy Notstrom protocol
items.intent: Reduce interaction load when the founder explicitly reports low energy or overload
items.rationale: A voluntary reduced-interaction route is useful. Triton prohibits inferred psychological state, surveillance, diagnosis and silent control weakening; the mode affects presentation and choice load only.
items.protected_outcome: Human-supportive interaction with autonomy and unchanged safety and quality controls
items.follow_up_trigger: The user explicitly requests or withdraws reduced-interaction mode

items.intent: Make customer, financial, quality, security and flow performance visible
items.rationale: The authoritative catalog and evidence-bound dashboard contract already require formula, source, population, as-of, owner, confidence and decision use. Antigravity's fixed green targets and generated values cannot be treated as live evidence.
items.protected_outcome: Decision-useful metrics without fabricated benchmark or status
items.follow_up_trigger: A controlled live source and accountable KPI target are approved

items.intent: Link material risk to prevention, contractual allocation, insurance and residual-risk decisions
items.rationale: The risk-transfer structure is useful. The source asserts complete liability ringfencing, policy coverage, insurer conditions and LIVE residual states without policy documents or legal review, and treats hashes and tests as negligence defence or compliance proof.
items.protected_outcome: Verified risk-transfer decisions without invented legal or insurance protection
items.follow_up_trigger: Executed policy wording, broker evidence or a material risk decision becomes available

items.source_item: Lean construction, Last Planner, Gemba, Poka-Yoke and bilingual T-cards
items.intent: Improve active-site readiness, visual control, trade handovers and defect containment
items.rationale: Pull planning, constraint removal, successor checks, visual aids and respectful cause analysis are useful. Fixed cadences, four-hour response, generic tolerances, reinforcement rules, penalties, payment gates and contractor ratings are project-, contract- and jurisdiction-specific.
items.protected_outcome: Buildable, inspectable work with project-owned technical and commercial authority
items.follow_up_trigger: An external project profile admits site-specific standards, language, inspections and commercial terms

items.source_item: TWI job instruction, visual SOP and Traveling Light knowledge transfer
items.intent: Transfer repeatable work through demonstration, supervised practice and concise operational aids
items.rationale: The TWI-style learning cycle and task-level visual aid are valuable. Fixed daily checks, 20-day habit claims, two-minute videos, ten-second search targets and unsafe example dimensions are not universal competence evidence.
items.protected_outcome: Practical knowledge transfer with task-risk-based competence evidence
items.follow_up_trigger: A repeatable task needs a controlled job instruction or competence route

items.source_item: Value pricing, target costing and anti-discounting policy
items.intent: Price from customer value and market alternatives while protecting sustainable delivery cost and margin
items.rationale: Value evidence, target cost and concession discipline are useful. A highest possible value ceiling, mandatory ceiling anchor, fixed 40-percent margin, proportional scope cut, invented avoided-loss anchor and fixed FPAR/RTY targets can be coercive or economically false and may compress protected work.
items.protected_outcome: Traceable sustainable pricing without unsupported value claims or quality compression
items.follow_up_trigger: A real customer value case, target-cost decision or concession request is prepared

items.source_item: Pepper psychological sensing and Jarvis anti-blank-page role changes
items.intent: Reduce cognitive friction and provide usable starting material
items.rationale: User-initiated choice reduction and useful scaffolds are retained in policies. Active psychological-state detection, fixed human slack, perfectionism diagnosis, zero-friction claims, 70-percent scaffolds and under-15-minute execution authority are excluded because they exceed role competence or bypass evidence-based tailoring.
items.protected_outcome: Helpful human-agent collaboration without diagnosis, manipulation or role-authority expansion
items.follow_up_trigger: A user explicitly requests interaction support or a recurring scaffold failure is evidenced

items.source_item: Generated enterprise and project dashboard suite
items.intent: Provide accessible visual explanations and a consolidated decision view
items.rationale: Triton's evidence-bound renderer already covers accessible explanations, escaping and self-contained output. Antigravity's builder hard-codes an external Windows destination, remote scripts, static live-looking values, fixed exchange rates and unsupported compliance/readiness labels; --sync does not ingest controlled state.
items.protected_outcome: Portable, source-backed dashboards that cannot impersonate operational truth
items.follow_up_trigger: A controlled live KPI source and approved dashboard data contract exist

items.source_item: Gemba Pulse web server and Pydantic live-update schema
items.intent: Capture mobile site, invoice and operator inputs and refresh decision views
items.rationale: Typed proposed inputs are useful, but the server binds every interface, has no authentication or CSRF protection, permits HTML path traversal, continues after validation failure, defaults approval evidence to true, converts money to float, invokes a builder as a POST side effect, does not persist validated values, and still returns success. Triton retains proposal-only, fail-closed intake rules and the existing read-only pulse; no server is activated.
items.protected_outcome: Safe evidence intake without unauthorised project, payment, acceptance or psychological-state mutation
items.follow_up_trigger: An authenticated project-owned intake service has an approved data route, threat model, tests and rollback

items.source_item: Ralja House architectural pitch deck inside the Company OS
items.intent: Present project architecture and value visually
items.rationale: A project presentation may be useful, but storing customer or product content in the generic Company OS violates the established external-workspace boundary and risks stale claims, mixed baselines and inappropriate publication. The capability belongs in the authorised Ralja workspace with project review.
items.protected_outcome: Separation of corporate controls from customer and project artefacts
items.authoritative_target: External Ralja project workspace under its own evidence and approval controls; no Company OS copy
items.follow_up_trigger: The Ralja project owner requests a project-local presentation under the project baseline
